name: 42 Hallows Street
source:
42 Hallows Street is a small horror visual novel created for the 6th Annual Spooktober Visual Novel Jam. You play as Noah Nova, a student trying to uncover the dark secrets of a mansion that holds a significant place in both his and his friend's past. As Noah delves deeper into its mysteries, he is forced to confront the inevitability of death.

[From [url=https://oldpat.itch.io/42-hallows-street]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《42 Hallows Street》是为第六届年度Spooktober Visual Novel Jam创作的小型恐怖视觉小说。你扮演诺亚·诺瓦（Noah Nova），一名学生，试图揭开一座豪宅的黑暗秘密，这座豪宅在他和他朋友的过去中占有重要地位。随着诺亚深入探究其奥秘，他被迫面对死亡的不可避免性。

[来自[url=https://oldpat.itch.io/42-hallows-street]itch.io[/url]]
